content.title: Applebee's® Restaurant Food Specials Today - Lunch, Dinner and Drinks!
content.text: Applebee's Restaurants Just Got More Special Restaurant deals, promotions, special offers... we have ‘em all so you can enjoy your favorites! A Special Birthday, The Applebee's Way End your special day with a birthday offer! After sharing great apps like our Chicken Wonton Tacos or Classic Combo, how does a free dessert sound? Get yours if you’re signed-up for Club Applebee’s® or join before your birthday for a sweet celebration.* Join Club Applebee's Double The Deal, Double The Fun! Enjoy incredible savings with Applebee's meal deal for 2, for a special dinner date, or enjoy it all to yourself! Either way, you get to choose two mouth-watering entrées + a full-size appetizer, like America’s Favorite Boneless Wings, all for a price you won’t find anywhere else. Order Now FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS While Applebee's doesn't offer specific monthly drink specials, we do feature exciting seasonal drink specials that are available for a limited time. Be sure to check our menu or ask your server about the current seasonal drinks being promoted, so you can enjoy our latest cocktail creations. Applebee’s offers a variety of enjoyable lunch specials that provide great value. Specials may vary by location and are subject to change. To find the latest lunch deals available near you, please contact your local Applebee’s restaurant today! Yes, Applebee's is proud to honor our nation's veterans and active-duty military personnel every Veterans Day, November 11th. We offer free meals from a special menu to veterans and active-duty military as a token of our appreciation for their service. To learn more about our Veterans Day Free Meals promotion and to view the special menu, please visit applebees.com/en/veterans-day-free-meals Yes, Applebee's offers a birthday special for guests who sign up for Club Applebees®. As a member, you'll receive a special birthday treat, such as a free dessert, to celebrate your special day. Visit our website or ask your server for more information on how to join our email club and start receiving exclusive offers and promotions.
